content: Russian market: existing salary calculators (kontur-extern, nalog-nalog, calcman, zarplata.ru, web-calculator.ru) are single-shot gross<->net/NDFL calculators for a given month, not forecasting/planning tools. Existing mobile apps (Gig, Мой расчёт ЗАРПЛАТЫ) target hourly/shift workers and freelancers, not salaried employees with progressive-NDFL forecasting, vacation-pay automation, or multi-device cloud sync. No direct competitor combining progressive NDFL cumulative forecast + auto vacation pay + salary history + annual pie chart was found.
